description:
My seller PCSd to Ft. Cavazos and closed with me on a stunning new home just 15 minutes from Stillhouse Lake! What makes this story even better? I helped him sell his 24-year-old home (built in 2000) in the same area and upgrade to a brand-new home closer to the boat ramp… all while keeping the SAME monthly mortgage payment.

He’s now living closer to Stillhouse Lake and Lake Belton, launching the boat in minutes, and still reeling in that financial peace of mind.

Dreams don’t work unless you do, and with the right guidance, they get a whole lot easier. Whether you’re PCSing, upsizing, or just ready for a fresh start, let’s make your move make sense.

Your next chapter starts here. Call/text me today! 254-226-8725

🧡 Jessica A. Baez, TX LIC REALTOR®.
